artifact.identity: Owner-supplied Mermaid Theme Builder Competitive, Academic, and Market Research Report
artifact.location: The latest substantive user message before review began; unchanged conversation artifact.
artifact.hash_limit: A byte-exact transcript file was not supplied or exported, so no source-message hash is claimed.

decision_question: Can the supplied report guide this existing app's next priorities within its current governance?

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Consequential academic and competitor facts are checked against dated primary sources; unsupported universal negatives are bounded.
Recommendations distinguish current implementation, untested behavior, remaining packaging gaps, and market hypotheses.
Recommendations respect the static browser architecture, approved brands, privacy, and existing dependency constraints.
Hosted visual parity, LLM adherence, demand, legal clearance, and defensibility are not claimed from source metadata or model agreement.

shared_model_or_source_limits: Three initial reviewers were dispatched before any reviewer finding was returned, with separate role briefs and execution contexts.
All roles inherited parent context and used the same model family; some sources overlap. Agreement is correlated, not independent market validation.
The disruptor intentionally received initial concordance. The parent served as negotiator and authored the review addendum.
No specialist legal review, customer study, competitor installation, external-renderer comparison, or protected LLM holdout ran.

initial_reviews.summary: Current sources contradict the strongest novelty claims and several paper, price, and upstream timeline assertions.

claims.claim: MermaidSeqBench reports 132 pairs and judge-dependent syntax scores of 92.01 and 68.89.
claims.limit: Judge scores are not compiler pass percentages or visual-compliance measurements.

claims.claim: GPT-4.1-mini entity F1 is below 0.94.
claims.correction: Table 1 gives entity F1 0.986 and relationship F1 0.979.

claims.claim: Mermaid Studio offers only editor-side theming autocomplete.
claims.correction: Documents per-family frontmatter application and JSON theme exchange.

claims.claim: Mermaid Studio lacks a relevant agent workflow.
claims.correction: Documents MCP validation/rendering and a generate-validate-render instruction scaffold.

claims.claim: Studio's type count and prices in the report are current.
claims.correction: 32 types; personal Core/Studio $25/$49 yearly, commercial $75/$149 yearly.

claims.claim: Mermaid Chart's relevant offering is limited to a prebuilt selector.
claims.limit: Vendor-documented custom styling and authenticated validation/rendering do not establish equivalent governance enforcement.

claims.claim: Chart's current entry price is $80 per user yearly.
claims.correction: Plus/Premium $10/$20 per user monthly billed annually; Basic allowances conflict on the page.

claims.claim: Mermaid v12 is only a future possibility.
claims.limit: Released v12 does not demonstrate the full compound kill condition.

claims.claim: No direct competitor exists and the inventory is exhaustive.
claims.next_test: Publish bounded feature criteria and compare current competitor exports on shared fixtures.

initial_reviews.summary: Much of Stage 1 already exists; metadata and historical observations do not prove hosted parity or demand.

claims.claim: Stage 1's contract/scaffold workflow is absent.
claims.next_test: Inventory and validate current exported artifacts.

claims.claim: Existing exports already equal the proposed complete bundle.
claims.limit: UI profile export does not populate semantic classes or embed the prompt; palette bundle is a palette collection.

claims.claim: Renderer profiles prove visual parity.
claims.next_test: Record dated host/plugin/version/configuration observations with fixture hashes and actual styling.

claims.claim: classDef can enforce equivalent semantics across all families.
500 weekly active exporters can be used as a current gate.
claims.limit: Sanitized pageviews do not measure unique weekly exporters.

claims.claim: Existing roadmap checkboxes accurately identify missing work.
claims.next_test: Reconcile source presence with separate runtime/readiness evidence.

initial_reviews.approved_use: Narrowed research direction with explicit scope limits.
initial_reviews.summary: Cloud login proposals conflict with governance; portability, deterministic LLM behavior, telemetry, and naming assurances lack adequate evidence.

claims.claim: A universal classDef library governs every family.
Init is the universal preferred portable encoding.
claims.next_test: Retain frontmatter and directives with measured target defaults.

claims.claim: Implicit derivation proves nondeterminism.
A scaffold deterministically makes an LLM comply.
claims.next_test: Run independently chosen generation/revision tasks and separate syntax, semantics, styling, and rendering metrics.

claims.claim: SSO and cloud themes are valid later app stages.
Search snippets and TOS silence imply legal naming safety.
claims.limit: Legal clearance not performed; informal searches do not establish rights.

concordance.basis: All initial roles deferred adopting the report as the roadmap and retained only a narrowed validation hypothesis.
concordance.scope_of_agreement: Research sufficiency and current app scope, not demand or product success.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Deterministic configuration application delivers equal or better realized styling with less effort than prompt retention.
falsification_hypotheses.decisive_test: Compare 12 shared generation/revision tasks with scaffold-only versus generation plus existing application; measure styles, semantics, repair count, and effort.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Same-version hosts/configurations disagree enough that a version-only parity matrix is not predictive.
falsification_hypotheses.decisive_test: Render unchanged fixtures under two identified configurations sharing a Mermaid version, with font/CSS/security settings recorded.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: A retained theme contract can preserve incorrect capability promises.
falsification_hypotheses.decisive_test: Vary journey color tokens on the pinned renderer and inspect computed styles before reconciling scaffold and registry.

test_results.result: Parent confirmed deterministic directive generation/application exists; comparative outcome trial not run.
Existing compatibility document contains unverified and installation-dependent entries; paired host trial not run.
Parent independently confirmed a textual journey-scaffold/registry contradiction; correct rendered capability not determined.

negotiator.rationale: Primary sources defeat several broad novelty and current-fact assertions; local source defeats greenfield Stage 1 framing. The strongest surviving objection is that contract retention can preserve incorrect promises and may add little over deterministic application. A small corrected validation study is useful, while commercial positioning and staged implementation remain unapproved.

approved_use: The reviewed addendum supports bounded study design with explicit caveats. It does not approve the supplied report for publication, roadmap adoption, enterprise architecture, renaming, dependency changes, or release.

checks.detail: Version, family count, skill count, and TypeScript checks passed.
Host Bash lacks mapfile. Exit 127; Linux CI checker not executed.

checks.detail: 13 relative links resolve; JSON parses; initial role structure and baseline hashes agree; historical bodies preserved beyond review notices; new review files contain no em dashes, trailing whitespace, or flagged US English variants. limitations: Live status refers to source retrieval and actual reviewer execution. Implementation and strategy conclusions are analytical.

Competitor pages are vendor claims, not observed runtime behavior.
Custom-styles page was retrieved by evidence reviewer; parent repeat fetch failed.
Historical compatibility observations were read, not rerun.
Paper correctness results do not measure styling or customer demand.
All proposed outcome trials and held-out LLM evaluations are not-run.

follow_up.owner: Project owner or a separately scoped executor
follow_up.action: Reconcile journey scaffold promises with pinned-renderer evidence, then validate current profiles/scaffolds against deterministic application and a small versioned family/host fixture set.
Obtain direct workflow feedback before adopting growth thresholds, a commercial moat claim, a name change, or enterprise scope.

review_expiry_trigger: Relevant competitor or upstream release, new hosted evidence, app contract/schema change, or direct user study.
